fieldHints.auth_enabled: Require an API key or passkey to access the dashboard and API.
fieldHints.hide_auth_off_notice: Hide the sidebar warning shown while authentication is disabled.
fieldHints.history_retention_days: How many days request history is kept before cleanup.
fieldHints.logs_retention_days: How many days logs are kept before cleanup.
fieldHints.max_concurrency: Maximum number of provider requests running at the same time.
fieldHints.max_attempts: Maximum attempts per provider before giving up.
fieldHints.user_agent: HTTP User-Agent header sent to providers.
fieldHints.retry_http_codes: HTTP status codes that trigger an automatic retry.
fieldHints.ap_retry_codes: Provider error codes that trigger an automatic retry.
fieldHints.public_origin: Public base URL of this instance, used for passkeys.
fieldHints.rp_id: WebAuthn relying party ID (the domain for passkeys).
fieldHints.rp_name: WebAuthn relying party name shown to users.
fieldHints.log_level: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error.
fieldHints.treat_empty_as_fail: Count an empty result set as a failed attempt.
fieldHints.ignore_request_count: Ignore the requested result count and return everything found.
fieldHints.allow_sparse_sources: Answer-node sources (link+title, often without a snippet) are added to the Row result.

mcp.title: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
mcp.subtitle: Expose SerpentSeek search to AI assistants as a tool over streamable HTTP (SSE + JSON-RPC) or plain HTTP JSON-RPC.
mcp.endpointHint: AI clients connect to this URL. Send the API key as a Bearer token. GET opens an SSE stream, POST sends JSON-RPC.
mcp.authNote: The endpoint requires the search scope: pass your API key in the Authorization header (Bearer).
mcp.toolSearchDesc: Runs a query through the active provider chain and returns title, URL and snippet for each result.
